nivāta:
[Ni+vāta]  CL=10 [natthi vāto etthāti nivāto. (Jā. Ṭī. 16. 519.)]
Where there is no wind, that is nivāta. Without wind, windless, sheltered from wind.
[nivāta] (masculine, neuter noun) [ni + vata + ṇa]
(1) Humility, submission. (adjective) (2) Having humble behavior, respectful, one who shows respect.
nivātaja: [Nivāta+jana+kvi]  CL=10 It grows where there is no wind (trees, etc.).

[Nivāta+ka]  CL=9 (1) vātavupakaṭṭha (noun):
- A place sheltered from wind/without wind
- A secluded/private place
(2) rahobhedi (noun):
- One who conspires/discusses in a secluded place
- One who causes destruction/harm in private
- A person who breaks confidentiality
